description:
Song Ha-Na, a famous beauty YouTuber and influencer, hastily moves back to her grandmother's house to live in the countryside when a product she advertises becomes embroiled in controversy and, to make matters worse, a malicious stalker approaches her. In the countryside, Hana meets Kim Deok-Su, a muscular, single bachelor who she's never met before. Her blushing and flustered reaction to even the slightest physical contact garners a heated response on her farming vlog. For Ha-Na, who can no longer broadcast her beauty products, the fit and handsome Deok-Su becomes a great broadcast topic, but for some reason, Deok-Su pathologically avoids Ha-Na...

Will Hana be able to successfully make a comeback as a YouTuber by featuring Deok-Su and generating views?!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
